description: A critical remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability exists in the GlobalProtect VPN portal of Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS. An unauthenticated attacker can exploit this by sending a specially crafted request to the portal, leading to root-level access on the firewall device.
remediation: Apply the latest security patches immediately. As a temporary workaround, disable telemetry and apply Threat Prevention signature 99999 if active.
